chrome.tabs.theme.note: Hidden: Arkemis keeps one dark look; printcraft's light, dark and system themes (view.theme, view.theme.light, view.theme.dark, view.theme.system) are not translated. Checked against printcraft 8f16855: commands.rs:329-336 and engine commands.rs:251-254 only set the app's own light, dark or system preference, which Arkemis does not offer.

chrome.mode.find-tools.note: printcraft chrome.rs:526 Find tools and commands (view.palette, Ctrl+K): puts the cursor in the title bar's search for tools and commands.

alltools.panel.search.note: printcraft panels/all_tools_ui.rs:66: the search of the expanded All tools view filters the tiles by tool name or item name. The title bar's search is view.palette.
